name: UK Data Protection & Online Safety Compliance (UK GDPR / OSA)
description: Compliance framework for the UK Data Protection Act 2018, UK GDPR, Privacy and Electronic Communications Regulations (PECR), and Online Safety Act 2023 (OSA), covering ICO reporting, UK International Data Transfer Agreements (IDTA), and child online safety duties of care.
owner: UK Regulatory Compliance & Data Protection Office

checklists.name: UK GDPR & Online Safety Act Verification Checklist
checklists.description: Validation checklist for UK DPA 2018, PECR, and Online Safety Act 2023 requirements.

items.statement: UK International Data Transfer Agreement (IDTA) or UK Addendum is executed for non-adequate destination countries.
Cookie consent mechanism satisfies PECR regulations requiring prior explicit consent before setting non-essential cookies.
Online Safety Act (OSA) illegal content risk assessment identifies mitigations against priority illegal content.
ICO personal data breach notification procedures guarantee reporting to the ICO within 72 hours.

reviewGates.name: UK DPO & Online Safety Gate
reviewGates.statement: The UK Data Protection Officer confirms that UK IDTA agreements, PECR cookie controls, and OSA risk assessments meet UK legal standards.
reviewGates.prompt: Does the UK privacy audit evidence confirm full compliance with UK GDPR and the Online Safety Act?
checklistIds: UK GDPR & Online Safety Act Verification Checklist

obligationDefinitions.title: Online Safety Act illegal-content risk assessment must be refreshed after material service changes
obligationDefinitions.description: The Online Safety Act requires a documented illegal-content and child-safety risk assessment that stays current with the service's actual functionality; a material feature change without a corresponding risk-assessment refresh leaves the compliance record stale.
obligationDefinitions.completionCriteria: The OSA risk assessment is refreshed within the declared window after any material service change.
obligationDefinitions.prompt: Has the OSA risk assessment been refreshed following this service's material change?
